text: Our Story Adly Chess Academy It all started on the chessboard in 2007; Ahmed Adly had achieved the title of World Junior Chess Champion after a difficult and obstacle-filled journey, training in the absence of certified trainers and qualified chess education center. This is not to mention ‘Egyptian clubs’ focus on more competitive sports. This is when the dream crystallized in his head and he sought to achieve it, to leave a footprint that marks the route for the next generation raising Egypt’s flag in international championships. That was the beginning, and ever since Adly had started training the children, he found the benefit mutual as he was enjoying this just as much as they were. After a huge amount of academic preparation, Adly began to realize his dream and established the first Egyptian Chess academy to be certified by the International Chess Federation in a professional manner, providing a safe environment for children as well as approved curricula. The dedicated team of required coaches work day and night to make sure this Academy becomes a home and haven for all chess professionals, children and youth. Whether your child is extremely intelligent or you find it difficult to deal with him, or even if he took up chess as a hobby after being taught by his grandfather, we invite you to teach him chess. “Why?”, do you ask? Because of our provision of effective curricula, certified trainers, and a positive competitive environment to nurture future world champions with both leadership and critical thinking skills. Vision Seeks to build a community of world class chess players who are not only exceptional athletes, but also outstanding human beings who are committed to using their talents to make a difference in the world. Mission We Believe in the power of chess to create champions with critical thinking and ethics. Our students will succeed today and be ready for tomorrow. Our Values At Adly Chess Academy, we believe students learn best and excel when they feel safe, valued and happy. Our expert coaches and staff are committed to providing the environment to cultivate their talents through encouraging personal growth and establishing self-esteem. All of The Academy’s members share the values and beliefs of reciprocation; rights must be provided and responsibilities must be done. Through our organized structure, we share your responsibility to assist students in learning appropriate behaviour. Adly Academy has a set of core values , which are constantly developed by parents and the academy management Cooperation Achievement Empathy Respect Fiar Play
